# komodo_tag (Resource)

Manages a Komodo tag for labeling resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "komodo_tag" "production" {
  name  = "production"
  color = "DarkRed"
}

resource "komodo_tag" "team_backend" {
  name  = "team-backend"
  color = "Violet"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Tag color. v2 uses a named-color enum: Slate, LightSlate, DarkSlate, Red, LightRed, DarkRed, Orange, LightOrange, DarkOrange, Amber, LightAmber, DarkAmber, Yellow, LightYellow, DarkYellow, Lime, LightLime, DarkLime, Green, LightGreen, DarkGreen, Emerald, LightEmerald, DarkEmerald, Teal, LightTeal, DarkTeal, Cyan, LightCyan, DarkCyan, Sky, LightSky, DarkSky, Blue, LightBlue, DarkBlue, Indigo, LightIndigo, DarkIndigo, Violet, LightViolet, DarkViolet, Purple, LightPurple, DarkPurple, Fuchsia, LightFuchsia, DarkFuchsia, Pink, LightPink, DarkPink, Rose, LightRose, DarkRose. Hex strings are no longer accepted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing tag by its Komodo ID.
terraform import komodo_tag.production 65a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1
```
